meta.name: Hinglish ASR Test Set
meta.author: Samyak
meta.purpose: Evaluation corpus for faster-whisper (large-v3, language=hi) on conversational Hinglish. Ground-truth text is the authoritative reference for WER measurement. Recording IDs H1-001 through H1-050 are Part 1 (recorded this day). H1-051 through H1-100 are Part 2 (scripted, to be recorded on Day 4).

recording_spec.naming: H1-NNN.wav where NNN is zero-padded ID
recording_spec.environment: Quiet indoor. No background music. Single speaker.
recording_spec.speaker: Human — real speech only. No TTS, no Piper, no synthetic audio.

meta.ground_truth_note: The 'text' field is the EXACT sentence the speaker is asked to say. It is the ground truth. It is NOT an ASR output and must NOT be modified after recording unless the recording is re-recorded.
